title: Large Command Strip Hook
author: Nad_Dude
description:
Hook sized to work with large command strips. Pull tab hides nicely under the hook but you can access easily with pliers when it's time to remove.

2 print profiles. One is stronger and has finer resolution. Looks great and can be displayed in a bathroom. Second print profile is lighter weight and prints faster, in 30 mins. A little more flexible but strong enough for most uses.
